# 🐙 Git Internals, Plumbing & Advanced Workflows Track

Welcome to the **Git Internals, Plumbing & Advanced Workflows Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering Git content-addressable object databases (Blobs, Trees, Commits, Tags), plumbing vs porcelain commands, interactive history rewriting (`rebase -i`), reflog disaster recovery, worktrees, bisect automated debugging, and repository maintenance.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-object-database` | Content-Addressable Storage | `.git/objects`, SHA hash addresses, 4 core object types, `git cat-file` |
| `01-plumbing-vs-porcelain-commands` | Plumbing & Low-Level Git | `hash-object`, `mktree`, `write-tree`, `commit-tree`, building commits manually |
| `02-staging-area-and-index-file` | Index & Staging Mechanics | `.git/index` binary format, patch staging (`git add -p`), `git diff --cached` |
| `03-branching-and-symbolic-refs` | References & HEAD | `.git/refs/heads/`, `.git/HEAD`, detached HEAD, lightweight vs annotated tags |
| `04-merging-strategies-fast-forward-and-recursive` | Merge Engines & Strategies | Fast-Forward, 3-Way Merge (ort engine), Merge Commits, conflict resolution |
| `05-interactive-rebase-and-history-rewriting` | Interactive Rebase | `git rebase -i` (pick, reword, squash, fixup, drop), linear commit history |
| `06-git-reset-soft-mixed-hard` | Reset Modes Decoded | `git reset --soft` vs `--mixed` vs `--hard`, staging area & tree states |
| `07-git-revert-and-safe-undo` | Safe Undoing with Revert | Public branch safety, `git revert -m 1` for merge commits, audit trail |
| `08-reflog-and-data-recovery` | Reflog & Disaster Recovery | `.git/logs/HEAD`, recovering deleted branches, `git fsck --lost-found` |
| `09-git-cherry-pick-and-patching` | Cherry-Pick & Patches | `git cherry-pick -x`, `git format-patch`, `git apply`, backporting fixes |
| `10-git-stash-and-worktrees` | Stash & Multiple Worktrees | `git stash push -u`, `git worktree add` (multi-branch simultaneous checkout) |
| `11-git-bisect-binary-search-debugging` | Automated Bug Hunting | `git bisect start/good/bad`, automated script execution (`git bisect run`) |
| `12-git-hooks-client-and-server` | Git Hooks Automation | `.git/hooks/`, `pre-commit`, `commit-msg` linting, Husky integration |
| `13-submodules-and-subtrees` | Submodules & Subtrees | `git submodule add/update`, `git subtree` monorepo component management |
| `14-git-lfs-and-large-files` | Git Large File Storage | Git LFS pointer files, `.gitattributes`, tracking large binaries & models |
| `15-git-attributes-and-ignore` | Attributes & `.gitignore` | Line endings (`text eol=lf`), custom diff filters, merge drivers, ignore rules |
| `16-distributed-workflows-and-remotes` | Remotes & Upstream | Remote tracking branches, `git pull --rebase`, forks, SSH key security |
| `17-repository-maintenance-and-packfiles` | Packfiles & Garbage Collection | `.git/objects/pack`, delta compression, `git gc --prune=now`, repo sizing |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 Git Internals gotchas + Reflog Branch Resurrection Master Drill |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `example.sh` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.sh` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.sh` — Complete reference solution.

**Technical Internals & Architectural Notes:**
— Git Content-Addressable Storage

## 🎯 The 4 Core Object Types
1. **Blob**: Raw binary file data (does NOT store filename or permissions!).
2. **Tree**: Directory listing mapping names and mode bits to blob/tree SHA hashes.
3. **Commit**: Points to root Tree, parent commit SHA(s), author, and commit message.
4. **Annotated Tag**: GPG-signed reference pointing to a specific commit.
